tree.label: Workspace
tree.note: The whole Notion workspace. Two halves: the sidebar (everything you navigate) and workspace settings (everything you administer). Zoom in and fall all the way down to a single block.

children.label: Sidebar
children.note: The left navigation. Your entry point to search, home, inbox, teamspaces, shared and private pages, settings, templates and trash.

children.label: Search
children.note: Quick find across the workspace (Cmd/Ctrl+P).

children.label: Notion AI
children.note: Ask, search and generate with AI across your pages.

children.label: Home
children.note: Personalized home: recents, upcoming events and tasks.

children.label: Inbox
children.note: All notifications, mentions and page updates.

children.label: Teamspaces
children.note: A team's home. Holds its pages and databases and controls who can see them. A workspace can hold many teamspaces.

children.label: Teamspace settings
children.note: Members, owners and the access level of the teamspace.

children.label: Members & owners
children.note: Add people and assign owners.

children.label: Open
children.note: Anyone in the workspace can join and view.

children.label: Closed
children.note: Discoverable; people request access; only members contribute.

children.label: Private
children.note: Invite only and hidden from everyone else.

children.label: Default
children.note: Every member is added automatically.

children.label: Database
children.note: A collection of pages that share properties. Same content engine as a page, but structured. This is the split from a page.

children.label: Data source
children.note: The underlying collection of rows. One database block can surface one or more sources.

children.label: collection
children.note: Each source has its own ID, property schema and rows.

children.label: Add a source
children.note: Combine another collection into this database. Each source keeps its own schema and rows.

children.label: Lock data source
children.note: Freeze the schema and rows of this source. Only owners can unlock it.

children.label: Pages (rows)
children.note: Every row IS a page. Open one and you are back in the Page world.

children.label: Open as page
children.note: A row opens as a full page. Click to bounce to the Page level.

children.label: Row properties
children.note: The property values for this row, shown in the database and on the page.

children.label: Row template
children.note: Pre-fill new rows from a saved template page.

children.label: Properties
children.note: Typed columns shared by every row.

children.label: Title
children.note: The name of every row. Required on every database.

children.label: Text
children.note: Free-form text column for notes and descriptions.

children.label: Number
children.note: Numeric values. Can feed formulas and rollups.

children.label: Select
children.note: Pick one option from a predefined list.

children.label: Multi-select
children.note: Tag rows with multiple options from a list.

children.label: Status
children.note: Track progress with grouped options like To-do, In progress and Done.

children.label: Date
children.note: A date or date range. Can include time and reminders.

children.label: Person
children.note: Assign one or more workspace members to a row.

children.label: Files & media
children.note: Attach images, documents and other files to a row.

children.label: Checkbox
children.note: A true/false toggle for simple flags.

children.label: URL
children.note: Store a clickable web link on the row.

children.label: Email
children.note: Email digests and alerts for workspace activity.

children.label: Phone
children.note: A phone number field.

children.label: Formula
children.note: Computed value from other properties using Notion formula syntax.

children.label: Relation
children.note: Link this row to rows in another database.

children.label: Rollup
children.note: Pull and aggregate values from a related database through a relation.

children.label: Created time
children.note: Auto-set when the row was first created.

children.label: Created by
children.note: Auto-set to whoever created the row.

children.label: Last edited time
children.note: Auto-updates whenever the row changes.

children.label: Last edited by
children.note: Auto-updates to whoever last edited the row.

children.label: Button
children.note: A clickable property that runs an automation.

children.label: ID
children.note: A unique auto-generated identifier for each row.

children.label: Place
children.note: A location field with an optional map preview.

children.label: Views
children.note: Different lenses on the same rows.

children.label: Table
children.note: Spreadsheet-style rows and columns. The default database view.

children.label: Board
children.note: Kanban columns grouped by a select or status property.

children.label: Timeline
children.note: Gantt-style view along a date range property.

children.label: Calendar
children.note: Rows plotted on a monthly calendar by date property.

children.label: List
children.note: Compact list of row titles with key properties.

children.label: Gallery
children.note: Card layout with large previews of cover images.

children.label: Chart
children.note: Bar, line or donut charts built from database data.

children.label: View options
children.note: Open pages in side peek / center / full, card preview, page size, shown properties, vertical lines.

children.label: Filters
children.note: Show only the rows that match.

children.label: Add filter
children.note: Add a rule to show only rows that match a property condition.

children.label: Condition
children.note: is / is not / contains / before / after.

children.label: And / Or groups
children.note: Combine multiple filter rules with AND or OR logic.

children.label: Advanced filter
children.note: Build nested filter groups for complex conditions.

children.label: Sorts
Ascending
children.note: Sort from lowest to highest (A–Z, oldest first).

children.label: Descending
children.note: Sort from highest to lowest (Z–A, newest first).

children.label: Multi-sort
children.note: Stack multiple sort rules with priority order.

children.label: Manual
children.note: Drag rows into a custom order. Stored as a manual sort property.
Order rows by one or more property values.

children.label: Groups
Group by
children.note: Group rows by a select, status, person or date property.

children.label: Sub-group by
children.note: Nest a second grouping inside the first.

children.label: Hide empty groups
children.note: Collapse columns or sections that have no rows.

children.label: Sort groups
children.note: Reorder group headers independently of the rows inside.

children.label: Color columns
children.note: Apply board column colors from the grouped property.
Named groups of members for bulk sharing.

children.label: Automations
children.note: When something happens, do something.

children.label: Triggers
children.note: Property edited, Page added, On a schedule, Button clicked.

children.label: Actions
children.note: Edit property, Add page, Send notification, Slack, Email, Webhook.

children.label: Templates
New template
children.note: Create a template page that pre-fills new rows.

children.label: Set as default
children.note: Auto-apply a template whenever a row is created.

children.label: Repeat on a schedule
children.note: Auto-create rows from a template on a recurring schedule.
Reusable blueprints for new database rows.

children.label: Page

children.label: Icon & cover

children.note: Emoji, upload or link.

children.label: Add cover
children.note: Banner image at the top of the page. Upload, link or pick from Unsplash.

children.label: Reposition
children.note: Drag to adjust which part of the cover image is visible.
Visual identity at the top of the page.

children.label: Title
children.note: The page name. Also the Title property when the page lives in a database.

children.label: Blocks
children.note: The content. Every line is a block you can drag, transform and nest.

children.label: 6-dot handle

children.label: Drag to move
children.note: Reorder the block among siblings on the same level.

children.label: Drag to nest

children.label: Add block
children.note: The plus and the slash menu to insert any block.

children.label: Add above / below

children.label: Block menu
children.note: Actions on the selected block.

children.label: Delete
children.note: Remove this block from the page.

children.label: Duplicate
children.note: Copy this block directly below the original.

children.label: Copy link to block
children.note: Get a direct URL that scrolls to this block.

children.label: Comment

children.label: Color

children.label: Turn into

children.label: Turn into page

children.label: Ask AI

children.label: Block types
